sources.title: Kyren Williams says Rams ‘Can’t play in the Super Bowl tomorrow’
sources.description: Kyren Williams joined in an interview with Kay Adams during Los Angeles Rams training camp, where Adams expressed that she was worried for the Rams because they are the favorites to win the Super Bowl.
